note: The Cerid orchestrator's coordinator (ADR-0135 §12 and §16, docs/design/ci-platform.md#the-cerid-orchestrator). No value here is secret: a key ending in _env reads that environment variable on the launcher (/etc/cerid-ci/launcher.env) and overrides a literal of the same name; secrets are Secret Manager names. Builds run only when the user decides (user orders 2026-10-31: no build per push, no nightly, no automatic bisection; GitHub Actions does the routine work): one starts with python ci/ops.py build start or New build, and it tests everything changed since the branch's last passing build; a repository's poll and schedules keys turn automatic builds back on, and quality.bisect the automatic first-bad-commit builds. Default access: the web UI through a Google IAP TCP tunnel (python ci/ops.py ui). Operator runbook: docs/recipes/ci-platform-setup.md.

ui.networks_note: iap-tunnel accepts the UI only from loopback and Google's IAP TCP-forwarding range 35.235.240.0/20; tailscale (optional add-on) needs allowed_logins; cloudflare-access and iap (load balancer) are the documented alternatives
